creators.name: 4th Wall Breakers
creators.role: Independent XR game studio behind CoasterMania and Pencil! on Meta Quest
creators.bio: 4th Wall Breakers makes mixed reality games for Meta Quest, including the roller coaster builder CoasterMania and the drawing app Pencil!. Its 2026 Meta VR Start entry, Wormhole Electric Co., is a puzzle game about reaching through portals to wire up a room.
creators.why: Keeps finding mixed reality mechanics where the player's own arm is the surprising part, not the graphics.
creators.role_zh: 独立 XR 游戏工作室，Meta Quest 上 CoasterMania 和 Pencil! 的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 4th Wall Breakers 为 Meta Quest 制作混合现实游戏，作品包括过山车搭建游戏 CoasterMania 和绘画应用 Pencil!。它在 2026 年 Meta VR Start 比赛中的参赛作品 Wormhole Electric Co. 是一款把手伸进传送门、给房间接电线的解谜游戏。
creators.why_zh: 总能找到这样的混合现实玩法：让人惊讶的不是画面，而是玩家自己的手臂。

creators.name: Table Connect
creators.role: Small team building remote board games on real tables for Meta Quest
creators.bio: Table Connect is a mixed reality project that lets two people in different places play a physical board game, each on their own real board. It launched as a checkers prototype for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026.
creators.why: Treats the physical board and pieces as the interface and uses the headset only to bring the other player to the table.
creators.role_zh: 为 Meta Quest 开发“在真实桌面上远程下棋”的小团队
creators.bio_zh: Table Connect 是一个混合现实项目：身处两地的两个人各自用自己的实体棋盘，一起下同一盘棋。它以国际跳棋原型的形式参加了 2026 年 Meta VR Start 开发者比赛。
creators.why_zh: 把实体棋盘和棋子当作界面，头显只负责把对手带到桌边。

creators.name: Astral Shores
creators.role: Independent developer of hand-tracked mixed reality games for Meta Quest
creators.bio: Astral Shores is the developer of WARP-OUT, a mixed reality brick breaker entered in the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026.
creators.why: Rebuilt one of the oldest arcade games around a single new verb: your two hands are the two ends of a portal.
creators.role_zh: 为 Meta Quest 制作手部追踪混合现实游戏的独立开发者
creators.bio_zh: Astral Shores 是 WARP-OUT 的开发者，这款混合现实打砖块游戏参加了 2026 年 Meta VR Start 开发者比赛。
creators.why_zh: 用一个全新的动作重做了最古老的街机游戏之一：你的两只手就是传送门的两端。

creators.name: Pixels of Eight
creators.role: Solo XR game developer (Pixels of Eight LLC) making games for Meta Quest and Apple Vision Pro
creators.bio: Pixels of Eight is a one-person XR studio. Its fingerboarding simulator Desk Session was built solo for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 and turns a scanned room into a miniature skate park.
creators.why: Gets a whole sport out of two fingertips and a desk, and scores what the board really did instead of which gesture you made.
creators.role_zh: 独立 XR 游戏开发者（Pixels of Eight LLC），为 Meta Quest 和 Apple Vision Pro 做游戏
creators.bio_zh: Pixels of Eight 是一人 XR 工作室。它的手指滑板模拟器 Desk Session 是为 2026 年 Meta VR Start 开发者比赛独立完成的，把扫描出来的房间变成一座迷你滑板公园。
creators.why_zh: 只用两根指尖和一张桌子就玩出一整项运动，而且评分看的是滑板真正做了什么，而不是你比了什么手势。

creators.name: Michael Cummings
creators.role: Developer building camera-and-display apps for Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses
creators.bio: Michael Cummings built ListLens during the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon (26 October to 4 November 2026): a grocery list on Meta Ray-Ban Display that crosses items off as he puts them in his basket.
creators.why: Shows what a small glasses display is good for: a list that updates itself because the glasses saw what your hands did.
creators.role_zh: 为 Meta Ray-Ban Display 眼镜开发“摄像头加显示”应用的开发者
creators.bio_zh: Michael Cummings 在 Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon（2026 年 10 月 26 日至 11 月 4 日）期间做出了 ListLens：一份显示在 Meta Ray-Ban Display 上的购物清单，他把东西放进购物篮，清单上对应的那一项就自动划掉。
creators.why_zh: 展示了眼镜上的小屏幕适合做什么：一份因为眼镜看见了你手上的动作而自己更新的清单。

creators.name: Daniel Oquelis
creators.role: Developer of Fashion Glass, a mixed reality outfit planner for Meta Quest 3
creators.bio: Daniel Oquelis built Fashion Glass for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 with Unity, the Meta XR SDK, Passthrough Camera Access and live restyling by Decart AI. It uses the mirror already hanging in your room as the place to try clothes on.
creators.why: Found the one surface in a room where a headset wearer can see themselves, and put the generative model exactly there.
creators.role_zh: Fashion Glass 的开发者，这是一款 Meta Quest 3 上的混合现实穿搭规划应用
creators.bio_zh: Daniel Oquelis 为 2026 年 Meta VR Start 开发者比赛制作了 Fashion Glass，使用 Unity、Meta XR SDK、Passthrough Camera Access，并由 Decart AI 做实时重绘。它把你房间里本来就挂着的镜子变成试衣服的地方。
creators.why_zh: 找到了房间里唯一能让戴头显的人看见自己的那块表面，并把生成模型正好放在那里。

creators.name: Ahmet O. Basar
creators.role: Independent developer of Kokobubu, an iPhone AR guide for physical devices
creators.bio: Ahmet O. Basar built Kokobubu as an independent experimental prototype for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon in autumn 2026. The open-source iPhone app answers a spoken question about a machine by marking the right control in AR, step by step.
creators.why: Makes a language model point instead of talk: the answer is a mark on the exact knob you should turn.
creators.role_zh: Kokobubu 的独立开发者，这是一款教人操作实体设备的 iPhone AR 向导
creators.bio_zh: Ahmet O. Basar 在 2026 年秋天的 Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon 上以独立实验原型的形式做出了 Kokobubu。这款开源 iPhone 应用听到你对一台机器的提问后，会在 AR 里一步一步标出该碰的那个控件。
creators.why_zh: 让语言模型用“指”来代替“说”：答案就是标在你该拧的那个旋钮上的记号。

creators.name: Be Bi
creators.role: Developer of Spatial Studio, a voice-driven interface design tool for Meta Quest 3
creators.bio: Be Bi built Spatial (Prototyping) Studio for the Productivity track of the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026: a mixed reality tool where a spoken sentence becomes a working screen on a true-size virtual device in your room.
creators.why: Uses mixed reality for the one thing a monitor cannot show a designer: the real size of a screen in the place it will be used.
creators.role_zh: Spatial Studio 的开发者，这是一款 Meta Quest 3 上用语音驱动的界面设计工具
creators.bio_zh: Be Bi 为 2026 年 Meta VR Start 开发者比赛的生产力赛道制作了 Spatial (Prototyping) Studio：在这款混合现实工具里，说一句话，就能在你房间里一台真实尺寸的虚拟设备上得到一个可以操作的界面。
creators.why_zh: 把混合现实用在显示器给不了设计师的那件事上：屏幕在它将被使用的地方到底有多大。

works.title: Wormhole Electric Co.
works.description: A mixed reality puzzle on Meta Quest: pairs of colored wormholes sit on panels and cages around the living room, and the player pushes a real hand into one to have it come out of its twin somewhere else. Reaching through, the hand carries plugs, cables and batteries past bars and walls until a lightbulb finally gets power and lights up.
works.description_zh: Meta Quest 上的一款混合现实解谜游戏：成对的彩色虫洞分布在客厅里的面板和笼子上，玩家把真实的手伸进其中一个，手就从另一处的孪生虫洞里伸出来。就这样隔着栏杆和墙壁，把插头、电线和电池送过去，直到灯泡终于通上电亮起来。
works.idea_en: Your arm is the puzzle piece: put a hand into one hole and it comes out of another across the room.
works.idea_zh: 你的手臂就是解谜的零件：把手伸进一个洞，它从房间另一头的洞里伸出来。
works.technique: Hand tracking drives a duplicated hand that is rendered at the exit portal with the matching offset and rotation, likely with clipping at the portal plane so the arm appears cut and continued; cables and batteries are physics objects, and everything is placed in Quest passthrough.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪驱动一只复制出来的手，按对应的位移和旋转渲染在出口传送门处，很可能在传送门平面做了裁剪，让手臂看起来被切断又在别处接上；电线和电池是物理物体，全部放置在 Quest 的透视画面中。
works.exercise_en: Build two linked circles in WebXR or Unity on a Quest: when a tracked hand crosses the first circle, draw a copy of it coming out of the second, and use it to press a button you could not otherwise reach. Twist: put the exit portal behind the player so they must work by looking over their shoulder.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Quest 上用 WebXR 或 Unity 做两个相连的圆：被追踪的手穿过第一个圆时，在第二个圆里画出一只伸出来的复制手，并用它去按一个原本够不着的按钮。变体：把出口传送门放到玩家身后，让他们只能回头看着操作。

works.title: Unframed
works.description: A mixed reality cinema for Meta Quest: a film plays on a big screen in the living room, and at chosen moments parts of it leave the frame. In the demo, made for Blender Studio's Singularity, a shockwave breaks open the wall behind the screen, a creature flies out to be fed from the viewer's palm, and a glowing seed held in two cupped hands changes as the story goes on.
works.description_zh: Meta Quest 上的混合现实影院：电影在客厅里的一块大屏幕上播放，到了设定的时刻，画面里的一部分会走出画框。这段演示以 Blender Studio 的 Singularity 为素材：冲击波震开屏幕后面的墙，一只小生物飞出来，在观众的掌心里吃东西；捧在双手里的一颗发光种子，会随着剧情推进而变化。
works.idea_en: Immersion as an optional track, like subtitles: a pack of 3D scenes and hand moments that plays in sync with a normal film.
works.idea_zh: 把沉浸感做成一条可以开关的轨道，就像字幕：一套与普通电影同步播放的三维场景和手部互动。
works.technique: The film runs on a virtual screen in passthrough while a timeline synchronised to the video triggers 3D scenes, room effects and hand interactions; the wall break likely uses the Quest room scan to cut a hole in the real wall, and the film was re-rendered in stereo from the open Blender assets.
works.technique_zh: 电影在透视画面中的虚拟屏幕上播放，一条与视频同步的时间线负责触发三维场景、房间特效和手部互动；震开墙壁的效果很可能利用 Quest 的房间扫描在真实墙面上开洞，影片本身则用 Blender 的开放素材重新渲染成立体画面。
works.exercise_en: Take a one-minute public-domain or Creative Commons clip, play it on a floating screen in WebXR or phone AR, and add three timed events that leave the frame at exact timestamps: an object that flies out, a light that spills onto the floor, and one thing the viewer can hold. Twist: add an on/off switch and ask classmates which moments felt better without the extra layer.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段一分钟的公有领域或知识共享授权的影片，在 WebXR 或手机 AR 里放到一块悬浮屏幕上，再在准确的时间点加入三个“走出画框”的事件：飞出来的一个物体、洒到地板上的一片光，以及一件观众可以拿在手里的东西。变体：加一个开关，请同学说说哪些时刻不加这一层反而更好。

works.title: Table Connect
works.description: Two people in different homes play checkers, each on a real board on their own table, seen through Meta Quest passthrough. The headset finds the 64 squares of the physical board, the opponent appears as an avatar sitting across the table and reaching for pieces, and glowing arcs and pillars show jumps, captures and crownings on top of the real pieces.
works.description_zh: 身处不同家里的两个人下国际跳棋，各自透过 Meta Quest 的透视画面看着自己桌上的实体棋盘。头显识别出实体棋盘的 64 个格子，对手以虚拟化身的样子坐在桌子对面伸手拿棋子，发光的弧线和光柱叠加在真实棋子上，标出跳吃、吃子和升王。
works.idea_en: Keep the real board and the real pieces; let the headset add only the missing person.
works.idea_zh: 保留真实的棋盘和棋子，头显只补上那个不在场的人。
works.technique: Passthrough Camera Access frames are unwarped on the GPU and analysed with OpenCV, together with MRUK table detection, to lock onto the physical board without markers; a hollow hand shader keeps real fingers visible over the pieces, and the remote player is shown as a Meta Avatar with inverse-kinematics arms and spatial voice.
works.technique_zh: 把 Passthrough Camera Access 的画面在 GPU 上做透视校正，再用 OpenCV 分析，并结合 MRUK 的桌面检测，不需要任何标记就能锁定实体棋盘；一个镂空的手部着色器让真实手指在棋子上方保持可见，远端玩家则以带反向运动学手臂和空间语音的 Meta Avatar 呈现。
works.exercise_en: Print a 4 x 4 grid, track it with a phone AR image target, and build a two-phone tic-tac-toe where each player places real coins on their own sheet and sees the other player's moves as virtual coins. Twist: show the remote player's last hand movement as a ghost trail so you can read hesitation as well as the move.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张 4 x 4 的格子纸，用手机 AR 的图像识别追踪它，做一个双手机的井字棋：每个玩家在自己的纸上放真实的硬币，对方的落子显示为虚拟硬币。变体：把远端玩家最后一次手部移动显示成幽灵轨迹，让你除了落子之外还能读出对方的犹豫。

works.title: WARP-OUT
works.description: A brick breaker floating in the living room on Meta Quest, with no paddle: each hand carries a round portal, joined by a translucent tube. The player catches the ball in one hand's portal, aims the other hand at the bricks and lets the ball shoot out of it, changing the portal size for easier catches or sharper shots.
works.description_zh: 一款悬浮在客厅里的 Meta Quest 打砖块游戏，没有挡板：两只手上各有一个圆形传送门，中间由一条半透明的管道相连。玩家用一只手的传送门接住球，另一只手对准砖块，让球从那里射出去；还可以改变传送门的大小，让接球更容易或射击更精准。
works.idea_en: Replace the paddle with a portal pair: one hand catches, the other hand aims.
works.idea_zh: 用一对传送门代替挡板：一只手接球，另一只手瞄准。
works.technique: Hand tracking places a portal disc on each palm; when the ball enters one disc it is re-emitted from the other along that palm's normal, and the distance or pose of the hands likely sets the portal size, with the play field anchored in passthrough.
works.technique_zh: 手部追踪在每个手掌上放置一个传送门圆盘；球进入其中一个圆盘后，会沿另一只手掌的法线方向重新射出，传送门的大小很可能由双手的距离或姿态决定，整个场地锚定在透视画面中。
works.exercise_en: Make a two-hand catch-and-redirect toy in WebXR hand tracking: balls fall from above, a disc on the left palm swallows them, and a disc on the right palm fires them toward targets on a real wall. Twist: give the two discs different sizes so one hand is the easy catcher and the other the precise shooter, then swap them mid-game.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 手部追踪做一个双手“接住再转向”的玩具：球从上方落下，左手掌上的圆盘把它吞进去，右手掌上的圆盘把它射向真实墙面上的目标。变体：让两个圆盘大小不同，一只手负责轻松接球，另一只手负责精确射击，并在游戏中途对调。

works.title: Desk Session: Fingerboarding Sim
works.description: Two fingertips ride a tiny virtual skateboard across a real desk in Meta Quest passthrough, grinding along books and dropping off the table edge. The scanned room is the skate park, extra rails and ramps are drawn or placed from a palm menu, and a thumb microgesture on the other hand flips the board.
works.description_zh: 透过 Meta Quest 的透视画面，两根指尖踩着一块小小的虚拟滑板在真实的书桌上滑行，沿着书本呲杆，再从桌边落下。扫描出来的房间就是滑板公园，额外的栏杆和坡道可以直接画出来或从手掌菜单里摆放，另一只手的拇指微手势用来让滑板翻转。
works.idea_en: Your desk is the skate park and two fingers are the skater; tricks are scored on what the board physically did.
works.idea_zh: 书桌就是滑板公园，两根手指就是滑手；动作按滑板实际发生的物理运动来评分。
works.technique: The board is a rigid body held to the tracked fingertips by magnet-like constraints of limited strength, MR Utility Kit turns the room scan into collision geometry, and Meta's thumb microgestures trigger flips while the scoring reads the board's actual rotation; parks persist per room and can be shared through colocation.
works.technique_zh: 滑板是一个刚体，靠强度有限的磁吸式约束附着在被追踪的指尖上；MR Utility Kit 把房间扫描结果变成碰撞几何体；Meta 的拇指微手势触发翻板，而评分读取的是滑板真实的旋转；滑板公园按房间保存，并可通过同地协作共享。
works.exercise_en: Attach a small physics board to two tracked fingertips with weak spring joints in Unity or WebXR, let it collide with a real table plane, and count a trick only when the board has truly rotated 360 degrees. Twist: let students build an obstacle from three real objects on the desk and compete for the longest grind.
works.exercise_zh: 在 Unity 或 WebXR 里用较弱的弹簧关节把一块小物理滑板连到两根被追踪的指尖上，让它与真实桌面发生碰撞，并且只有当滑板真的转满 360 度时才算完成一个动作。变体：让学生用桌上的三件真实物品搭一个障碍，比谁呲杆的距离最长。

works.title: ListLens: a grocery list that checks itself off
works.description: Filmed in a real supermarket through Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses: a grocery list sits in the corner of the wearer's view, and when he takes a carton from the shelf and drops it in his basket, the matching line is crossed off. He never takes out his phone or touches the list.
works.description_zh: 在真实超市里透过 Meta Ray-Ban Display 眼镜拍摄：购物清单停在佩戴者视野的一角，他从货架上拿起一盒东西放进购物篮，清单上对应的那一行就被划掉。整个过程他没有掏出手机，也没有碰过清单。
works.idea_en: The action is the input: putting the thing in the basket is what ticks the box.
works.idea_zh: 动作本身就是输入：把东西放进篮子，就等于打了勾。
works.technique: The glasses stream their camera to an iPhone through the Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit, the Muse Spark model reads what is in the hand, whether it is going into the basket and which list item it matches, and a cart watcher on the phone turns those answers into check-offs sent back to the display.
works.technique_zh: 眼镜通过 Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit 把摄像头画面传到 iPhone，Muse Spark 模型判断手里拿的是什么、是否正被放进购物篮、对应清单上的哪一项，手机上的“购物车观察器”再把这些判断变成划勾，传回眼镜的显示屏。
works.exercise_en: Write a five-item checklist for a desk task such as packing a pencil case, point a phone or webcam at the desk, and send a frame every two seconds to a vision model that answers which item just went into the case; cross it off on screen with no touch input. Twist: make the list notice a wrong item going in and ask the user to take it out.
works.exercise_zh: 为一件桌面小任务（比如收拾笔袋）写一份五项清单，用手机或网络摄像头对着桌面，每两秒把一帧画面发给视觉模型，让它回答刚刚放进去的是哪一项，然后在屏幕上自动划掉，全程不用触摸输入。变体：让清单发现放错了东西，并提醒用户把它拿出来。

works.title: Fashion Glass
works.description: Wearing a Meta Quest 3, the user stands in front of the real full-length mirror in their room, which the app outlines and surrounds with garment buttons. A curved rail of virtual shirts and jackets hangs within reach; the user grabs one, and the reflection in the mirror is restyled live so they see themselves wearing it, while an assistant called Glassy comments on the look.
works.description_zh: 用户戴着 Meta Quest 3 站在房间里那面真实的全身镜前，应用给镜子描出边框，并在周围放上衣物按钮。一条弧形衣架挂着虚拟的衬衫和外套，伸手可及；用户抓起一件，镜中的倒影就被实时重绘成自己穿着它的样子，名叫 Glassy 的助手还会点评这身搭配。
works.idea_en: Use the mirror you already own as the display: only the reflection changes clothes.
works.idea_zh: 把你本来就有的镜子当作显示器：换衣服的只有镜中的倒影。
works.technique: Passthrough Camera Access captures the mirror region of the headset's view, Decart's real-time video model restyles that image with the chosen garment, and the result is likely drawn back over the mirror's outline; garments are picked from the rail with hand tracking.
works.technique_zh: Passthrough Camera Access 截取头显视野中镜子所在的区域，Decart 的实时视频模型按选中的衣物重绘这部分画面，结果很可能再叠回镜子的轮廓之内；衣物通过手部追踪从衣架上选取。
works.exercise_en: Mark the four corners of a real mirror in phone AR or on a Quest, crop that region from the camera image, and run it through any image filter or style model before drawing it back inside the frame. Twist: change only the reflection's surroundings instead of the person, so the mirror shows you standing in another place.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 或 Quest 上标出一面真实镜子的四个角，从摄像头画面中裁出这块区域，用任意图像滤镜或风格模型处理后再画回镜框里。变体：不改人，只改倒影里的环境，让镜子显示你站在另一个地方。

works.title: Kokobubu: shows you where to touch
works.description: The user points an iPhone at an unfamiliar washing machine and asks out loud how to run a cool wash. Green corner brackets lock onto the exact knob on the real panel, a side card gives one step at a time, and after the user turns the knob the app checks a photo and confirms that the setting is right before moving on.
works.description_zh: 用户把 iPhone 对准一台不熟悉的洗衣机，开口问怎样洗一次冷水洗。绿色的角标框住真实面板上的那一个旋钮，旁边的卡片一次只给一步；用户拧好旋钮后，应用会根据照片检查并确认设置正确，再进入下一步。
works.idea_en: An assistant that points instead of explaining, and then checks that you did it right.
works.idea_zh: 一个用“指”代替“讲解”的助手，而且还会检查你有没有做对。
works.technique: Muse Voice Transcribe turns the question into text, Muse Spark reads the device and plans the steps, SAM 3.1 segments the exact control in the image, ARKit with LiDAR anchors the mark on the real control, and Muse Spark verifies each result from a photo; a small server holds the model keys.
works.technique_zh: Muse Voice Transcribe 把提问转成文字，Muse Spark 读懂设备并规划步骤，SAM 3.1 在图像中分割出确切的控件，ARKit 配合 LiDAR 把标记锚定在真实控件上，最后由 Muse Spark 根据照片验证每一步的结果；模型密钥放在一个小型服务器上。
works.exercise_en: Choose one appliance in the classroom, such as a microwave or a printer, and build a phone AR guide that anchors a marker on each control in the order of a task; advance only when the user taps to confirm what they see. Twist: replace the tap with a photo check by a vision model, and record the cases where it wrongly says the step is done.
works.exercise_zh: 在教室里选一台电器（比如微波炉或打印机），做一个手机 AR 向导，按任务顺序把标记依次锚定在每个控件上，用户点击确认自己看到的状态后才进入下一步。变体：把点击换成由视觉模型检查照片，并记录它误判“这一步已完成”的情况。

works.title: Spatial Studio: say an interface, see it at true size
works.description: In Meta Quest 3 passthrough, the user describes an app screen out loud and an AI design agent builds it on a life-size virtual phone floating above the desk, offering three options to pick with a pinch. The user points at an element and says the change, twists a wrist on a color dial, and moves the same design onto a laptop, a wall screen that stretches from 55 to 70 inches, or a station platform display.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 的透视画面中，用户口头描述一个应用界面，AI 设计智能体就把它做在一台悬浮在书桌上方、真实尺寸的虚拟手机上，并给出三个方案供捏合选择。用户指着某个元素说出要改的地方，转动手腕拧一个颜色旋钮，还能把同一个设计搬到笔记本电脑、从 55 英寸拉大到 70 英寸的墙面屏幕，或者车站站台的显示屏上。
works.idea_en: Prototype interfaces at their real size, on the device and in the place where they will be used.
works.idea_zh: 按真实尺寸做界面原型，放在它将被使用的设备上和场所里。
works.technique: Speech is transcribed and sent to a language-model design agent that likely returns web-style layout code rendered onto true-scale device models; pointing rays from hand tracking select elements for spoken edits, and a pinch-and-twist gesture maps wrist rotation to hue.
works.technique_zh: 语音被转成文字后交给一个基于语言模型的设计智能体，它很可能返回网页式的布局代码，再渲染到真实比例的设备模型上；手部追踪发出的指向射线用来选中元素并口头修改，“捏住再拧”的手势把手腕的旋转映射成色相。
works.exercise_en: Print or measure the real sizes of a phone, a tablet and a 55-inch television, show one web page on three virtual screens of exactly those sizes in WebXR or phone AR, and note which text becomes unreadable from where you stand. Twist: add one voice command that changes the font size, and find the smallest size that works on each device at its real viewing distance.
works.exercise_zh: 打印或量出一部手机、一台平板和一台 55 英寸电视的真实尺寸，在 WebXR 或手机 AR 里把同一个网页显示在三块尺寸完全一致的虚拟屏幕上，记下从你站的位置看哪些文字已经读不清。变体：加一条改变字号的语音指令，找出每种设备在真实观看距离下还能看清的最小字号。

leads.name: Mike Kim — Sunpatch
leads.why: Learn AR with SPECS hackathon (Devpost): pinch a window and a patch on the floor shows where its sunlight lands now, on Dec 21 and on Jun 21; grab the sun and drag it along its path. Very clear idea, but the video (rxpjXDP3eac) is a Lens Studio preview, not recorded on glasses; add when on-device footage exists.

leads.name: Radha Rani Basak — Redline
leads.why: Learn AR with SPECS hackathon: fills your own empty venue with a life-size ghost crowd at a density you choose, so stewards can stand inside the 5-people-per-square-metre danger line. Video (H1h7XHV2v-U) is a Lens Studio preview only.

leads.name: Learn AR with SPECS hackathon cluster (Miller & Müller — Sound Bearings; JonathanSolvesProblems — Floorcount; Furin — Tamago Coach; Haval Zebari — Cutaway; 余梓丞 — The Incense Ball)
leads.why: AI-coded Specs Lenses with strong single ideas: a ring showing where a sound comes from (2AH9xMOYwoA), salsa footprints lighting on the floor on the count (n4pGnXYn0ys), a countdown ring on the pan rim for rolling tamagoyaki (K7lrDOghO_E), taking a copy of an everyday object apart (APZkHGdODLE), a Tang-dynasty gimbal incense ball you roll and dismantle (1XNjROSSUHc). All are Lens Studio preview recordings that have not run on glasses; revisit after the hackathon results.

leads.name: Spectacles Community Challenge #17 winners (Aadarsh Pandey — After Hello; Natasha Gubernov — Pottery AR; Daria LASTXLR — Wondermarks; Steven Wolpe — Jurnee; Kavin Kumar — Spatial Mapper)
leads.why: Announced 2026-11-13: ASL-to-captions conversation aid for two people, two-handed clay throwing with a kiln and a shelf you can smash pots from, landmarks placed on a world map, an AR journal with a butterfly guide, and tracing a real projector's light outline for projection mapping. No public video found for any of them; check the creators' X, LinkedIn and r/Spectacles.

leads.name: Amir Mohideen Basheer Khan — SpecsGrip
leads.why: Spectacles Community Challenge #17 (Open Source, 1st): Specs hand tracking mirrors all 20 joints of your hand onto a Tesollo Delto DG-5F robot hand in real time. The only video is an mp4 in the GitHub README (user-attachments/assets/089905e0-afa3-4d06-90e4-105c6f981827, checks ok) that was not watched in this round; add if it shows the real robot hand.

leads.name: Firechant — Puttscape
leads.why: Multiplayer mini golf for XREAL AURA (Android XR) with hand-tracked putting, a course generated from your room and a venue mode run from a Pixel Fold. The 8-minute devlog (Twiu_hiEY4U) mixes talking head and AI-generated cutscenes; look for a short see-through gameplay clip before adding.

leads.name: AnySketch Neo (Meta Quest 3 prototype)
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: pin a line-art stencil on your real desk or wall in passthrough and trace it with a real pencil on real paper; any photo becomes a stencil. Real headset footage, but the video (bAr1OsbbcWQ) fails check_video (embedding disabled, HTTP 401).

leads.name: Sushant Srikrish — Chartrise
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: a strategy game laid flat on the real desk like a giant tablet, so every virtual button has a solid surface under the finger; the battle can rise into a hologram or be entered at full scale. Real Quest 3 footage (Bobl1g3LGKI); a good passive-haptics example if a further Quest round is wanted.

leads.name: Matthew Neuffer — Sneak-A-Snack
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: a two-player camp game where hand shadows on a tent wall are the only way to communicate which snacks to grab. Fully VR rather than mixed reality (CUzi74dLO7Q), but a strong hand-shadow-as-language idea next to the existing hand-shadow lead.

leads.name: Clarke Plumo Dev — Soothing Bots
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: sixteen floating robot heads sing a story song in mixed reality, each voice coming from its own head; wake them with a pinch, carry them around the room, and they answer a peace sign, a wave or a high five (ZVg9R9TkKnc). Not viewed frame by frame in this round.

leads.name: Tenstud (Argi Tendo) — THROUGH
leads.why: Meta VR Start 2026 entry: open a portal in your wall onto a fading garden, rescue sprouts and guide rain and light with bare hands until giant blooms grow into your own room (_xMdysRSQIE, actual gameplay according to the description). Check the footage before adding.
